title: Inboxes
expired: This inbox expired. It stays here, read-only, until it's removed within the hour.
deleteConfirm: Delete {address}? Its threads, drafts and labels go with it, and its API keys stop working.

edit.title: Edit inbox
edit.fromNameHint: The From name on mail this inbox sends. Empty: the address alone.

attention.drafts: {count, plural, one {# draft to approve} other {# drafts to approve}}

empty.title: No inboxes yet
empty.body: Create an address that receives mail. Agents read it over the API, webhooks or MCP; people read it here.
empty.noReceiving: Turn on receiving for a domain first, or use the shared domain.

limit.reached: You've used all {limit} inboxes on your plan. <link>Upgrade</link> to create more.
limit.full: You've reached the inbox limit of your plan. Upgrade to create more.

create.title: Create inbox
create.addressHint: Your domains with receiving on, or the shared {domain}, ready with no DNS.
create.name: Name
create.agentHint: Threads, reply API, code and link extraction, injection guard, drafts that wait for approval. Mail sent from its address follows its rules, through the API too: pick an address your app doesn't already send from.
create.humanHint: Read and reply in the dashboard, forward to a mailbox, route to a webhook.

errors.taken: This address is already in use.
errors.rate: Too many inboxes created in the last hour. Try again later.
errors.localPart: Use lowercase letters, digits and . _ % + - (up to 64), with no dot at either end.

message.quarantined: Held in quarantine: your agent can't see it until someone releases it.

reason.approval_required: the agent asked for a person
reason.require_approval: every reply from this inbox needs approval
reason.send_policy: a new recipient for this inbox's send rules
reason.private_code: it contains a code or sign-in link this inbox received
reason.loop_guard: a reply to an automatic message
reason.loop_burst: too many automatic replies to this address
reason.inbox_send_cap_reached: the inbox's daily send limit was reached
reason.restricted_api_key: a key restricted to another inbox
reason.shared_domain: shared-domain addresses only reply in their threads
reason.approved: sent by a person or a full-access key
reason.trust_sender: the sender went on the allowlist

downloadsBlocked: Downloads are blocked: this email carries malware.

gray.dmarcPassNone: DMARC gray: the message passed DMARC, but the sender's domain publishes p=none, so receivers aren't asked to block mail that fails.
gray.dmarcFailNone: DMARC gray: the message failed DMARC, and the sender's domain publishes p=none, which doesn't ask receivers to block it.
gray.dmarcNoRecord: DMARC gray: the sender's domain has no DMARC policy.
gray.dmarcGeneric: DMARC gray: the sender's domain doesn't ask receivers to block mail that fails (p=none, or no policy).
gray.dkimPolicy: DKIM gray: a valid signature from {domains}, not from the From domain, so it doesn't prove who wrote it.
gray.spfSoftfail: SPF gray: the sending server isn't listed by the sender's domain, which asks only for a soft fail.
gray.spfNeutral: SPF gray: the sender's domain doesn't say which servers may send for it.
gray.checkError: Couldn't be checked (a DNS timeout or a malformed record).

received.title: All received
received.hint: Every email your domains received, including addresses without an inbox.
received.emptyHint: Turn on receiving for a domain in <link>Domains</link>, then point its MX record here.
received.noMatch: No received emails match these filters.

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this email now? It can't be undone.
detail.linkElsewhere: The link points to a domain other than the sender's.

compose.subject: Subject
compose.drafted: Held for approval. It's waiting in Needs review.

safety.whoCanWriteHint: Mail that fails these rules is quarantined: it's stored and listed, but your agent never receives it until a person releases it.
safety.verifiedHint: DMARC-aligned senders, replies in known threads, and the allowlist.
safety.allowlistHint: Only the addresses and domains below.
safety.screeningHint: Scores mail from external and unauthenticated senders from 0 to 100; at 80 or more it's quarantined. One signal on top of the rules, not a guarantee. Read it as screening.injection_score.
safety.hiddenTextHint: Removes text a person can't see (hidden elements, white-on-white, zero-width and Unicode tag characters) from text and markdown. The original HTML stays in the raw message. Always on.
safety.extractCodesHint: Adds extracted.code and extracted.link for verification emails, so an agent never has to parse HTML.
safety.requireApprovalHint: Off: drafts wait only when a rule asks for it (the API sets requires_approval).
safety.privateCodes: Codes and magic links stay private
safety.privateCodesHint: An extracted code or sign-in link can't be sent or forwarded to anyone but you and the allowlist.
safety.forwardToHint: Team members' addresses and the owner addresses below.
safety.alwaysOn: Always on: replies carry Auto-Submitted and never answer another auto-reply, and first-contact sends go through the same abuse review as any send.
safety.adminOnly: Only owners and admins can change these rules.

policy.reply_onlyHint: New conversations to new recipients become drafts that wait for a person.
policy.allowlist: Replies, plus new conversations with the allowlist
policy.sharedOnly: Addresses on the shared domain only reply inside their threads.

email.drafted: Held a send as a draft

code.read: Read a code or sign-in link
